caption: The video captures a nighttime laser show in a narrow plaza flanked by illuminated buildings and a darker facade with a lit window. A horizontal metal truss spans the scene, while silhouetted spectators stand clustered near a small tent and a lone figure at the far right edge. Green beams project from a low central point, fanning upward through visible haze. The dense spray continuously reshapes, opening into wider fans and broad horizontal sweeps across the left and right sides. A bright sheet-like glow blooms overhead in the smoke, then spreads into wide, hazy beams. A yellowish-white diagonal streak appears among the green rays near the center and persists through the changing display. The beam fan tilts toward a near-horizontal orientation, projecting a large illuminated curtain across the right plaza. The far-right figure stays at the edge while the crowd silhouettes mostly remain in place as the light pattern keeps shifting.
